alt: A vast, sunlit rice paddy field during the day.
Farmers harvesting golden rice during sunset.
Woven sacks filled with high-quality white rice.
A close-up shot of individual grains of uncooked rice.
Stunning aerial view of cascading rice terraces.
A bowl of perfectly cooked, steaming white rice.

A high-angle, close-up shot of a dark brown ceramic bowl overflowing with fluffy, long-grain white basmati rice, topped with a fresh green coriander sprig, set against a warm, softly blurred wooden background.
A vibrant, close-up shot of golden, ripe rice grains on a stalk in the foreground, looking over a vast, sun-drenched paddy field stretching into a misty, golden sunrise.
A wide-angle shot of a massive blue cargo ship stacked high with neat rows of multi-colored shipping containers, cruising across a deep blue, open ocean under a clear, bright sky.

A dynamic perspective shot of a large cargo ship sailing through blue water, heavily stacked with colorful shipping containers. The left side features a sharp diagonal split showing a vibrant orange background patterned with subtle, stylized rice grain shapes.

A promotional image for Anand Global Foods, split into a bold orange banner and a photograph. The left-side orange banner contains the large, white text title SUPPLY CHAIN DEDICATION and the smaller text subtitle From our door to theirs, delivering satisfaction. The right-side photograph shows a close-up of two hands in the foreground holding a large, brown cardboard box labeled with the green text AGF ANAND GLOBAL FOODS. In the background, the open rear cargo bay of a white delivery truck is visible, containing several other stacked brown cardboard boxes on a wooden pallet under a blue sky with clouds. Smaller boxes inside the truck are also marked with the AGF label.

A clean, unbranded photograph of a delivery being made. A close-up view shows two hands in the foreground holding a large, unmarked, plain brown cardboard box. In the background, the open rear cargo bay of a white delivery box truck is visible, filled with multiple other stacked brown cardboard boxes on a wooden pallet. The far background beyond the truck shows a blue sky with clouds and distant trees.
